name: Bitter/Sweet Blythe
source:
Life isn't easy when you're different. When you're afraid of things that others seem to handle with ease. I'm so, so scared of the world. Scared to leave home in case I wind up in some kind of accident, or worse, in case a stranger tries to speak to me. Scared to hang out with my one and only friend in case they start to wonder why we're even friends in the first place. Scared to try anything new in case I fail and look stupid. Scared of being stuck like this forever...

I want to live rather than just exist. I want to be happy. And most of all, I don't want to spend my birthday all alone again. Is that too much to ask?

On their birthday, Bunnie (renameable + pick your pronouns) makes a wish, but will they get more than they bargained for when a bunny-eared being named Blythe shows up to give them their best-ever birthday?

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/bittersweetblythe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与众不同的人，生活总是不容易。别人似乎轻而易举就能应付的事，你却会害怕。我真的、真的好怕这个世界。害怕出门，怕遭遇意外，更怕有陌生人来和我搭话。害怕和唯一的朋友相处，怕对方开始怀疑，我们当初究竟为什么会成为朋友。害怕尝试新事物，怕失败后显得很蠢。害怕自己永远都只能这样下去……

我想好好生活，而不只是活着。我想快乐。而最重要的是，我不想再独自过生日了。这要求很过分吗？

生日当天，Bunnie（可改名、可选择人称代词）许下了一个愿望。随后，一位名叫Blythe、长着兔耳的存在出现了，要让Bunnie度过有生以来最棒的生日。但这个愿望带来的，会不会远超预期？

[摘自[url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/bittersweetblythe]Itch.io[/url]]
